reason: Adds a web UI Skills tab for searching available skills and toggling their model invocation status, persisting changes by updating SKILL.md frontmatter.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中提供技能列表、搜索以及单个或批量启用和禁用功能，并将状态写入技能的 SKILL.md 前置元数据。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH web UI tab for listing, searching, and individually or bulk enabling or disabling skills by updating their SKILL.md frontmatter.

capabilities: Adds a Skills tab to the DSH web UI
Enables or disables individual or visible groups of skills
Reads and rewrites skill SKILL.md frontmatter on disk
Provides a POST API route for skill toggles
